_note: TTS list prices used by tools/audio/cost_plan.mjs. Every row says where it came from and whether it was actually seen on a fetched page during the lane-4 round-2 session (2026-11-03). verified:true means the figure appeared on the cited page/API response that day; it does NOT mean the quote is what a contract would charge (taxes, currency, region, enterprise discounts, free-tier resets are not modelled). No live TTS API was called to produce this file.

azure.label: Azure AI Speech (Foundry Tools), text to speech

hebrewVoices.note: Voice names come from the project notes; not re-checked against Microsoft's voice list this session.

rows.label: Neural (standard) real-time
rows.source: https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices (Azure Retail Prices REST API; filter serviceName eq 'Foundry Tools', meterName contains 'Neural', armRegionName eq 'eastus', USD)
rows.evidence: Item: productName 'Azure Speech', meterName 'S1 Neural Text To Speech Characters', unitOfMeasure '1M', retailPrice 15.0, effectiveStartDate 2024-02-01. Also 'Emb Neural Text to Speech Characters' 15.0 effective 2026-11-01.
rows.caveat: That he-IL-AvriNeural / HilaNeural are billed under this S1 Neural meter is inferred, not read from a page. The retail API does not name voices.

rows.label: Neural HD
rows.evidence: meterName 'Neural HD Text to Speech Characters', unitOfMeasure '1M', retailPrice 22.0, effectiveStartDate 2026-03-01.
rows.caveat: Whether any he-IL voice exists in the HD family is not verified.

freeTier.evidence: Page text: 'Current F0 tier: Neural | 0.5 million characters free per month'. The same fetch rendered every price cell as '$-' ('Pricing is not available in the selected region'), so the page itself gave no USD prices; the USD figures above come from the Retail Prices API.

charCounting.note: How Azure counts combining niqqud marks and SSML tags was not confirmed on a fetched page. The plan shows both with-niqqud and letters-only counts.

charCounting.evidence: 'The total number of characters in the input string are counted for billing purposes, including spaces and newline characters. All SSML tags (except the <mark> tag) are also included in the character count.' For WaveNet/Standard the character count is 'equal to or less than the number of bytes'; the page does not say how combining marks (niqqud) are counted.

google.otherNotes: Token-priced speech engines are not in this plan: per-character budgeting does not apply and Hebrew suitability is untested.

rows.caveat: Quality for Hebrew pointed text untested.
